guest_identity_split_stress.purpose: Stress the browser-local guest identity weakness without using new outcomes.
guest_identity_split_stress.method: For every guest voter with more than 15 counted ballots, split that voter's ballots deterministically into two synthetic guest identities by alternating chronological ballots, then reapply the same 30-effective-vote per-identity cap and 0.50 guest multiplier.
guest_identity_split_stress.interpretation: This approximates one identity reset per sufficiently active guest. It is intentionally adverse because browser-local guest identities are not durable person identifiers.

leave_one_voter_out.population: Every distinct counted league or guest voter in the frozen snapshot.
leave_one_voter_out.comparison: Candidate 0.50 guest-weight ranking with one voter removed versus the full candidate ranking.
metrics: Spearman rank correlation on common players

selection_rule: The 0.50 candidate becomes ACTIONABLE_FOR_PROMOTION_SHADOW only if every primary unseen robustness gate passes. Weight-sensitivity diagnostics are descriptive and cannot rescue a failed primary gate.
promotion_rule: A pass authorizes only a separate production-candidate shadow. This phase cannot change Market Value V1 or any live consumer.
